endpoints.GET /health: Service health; authentication is not required.
endpoints.GET /channels: Channel schedules and enabled publishing targets.
endpoints.GET /queue: Queue jobs; optional channel and status query filters.
endpoints.GET /jobs/next: Next READY and due job; optional channel and include_future filters.
endpoints.GET /jobs/{job_id}/publish-payload: Resolved asset, caption, tags, schedule, audience, AI-generated disclosure, and safe visibility options for one platform.
endpoints.POST /sync: Rescan episode metadata and local assets while preserving active results.
endpoints.POST /validate: Validate configuration, metadata, captions, and queue generation.
endpoints.POST /jobs/{job_id}/approve: Check required assets and approve with body {approved_by}; writes approval and local asset references to episode metadata.
endpoints.POST /jobs/{job_id}/claim: Claim a READY job with body {agent_id}.
endpoints.POST /jobs/{job_id}/platform-result: Record {platform, status, remote_id, url, error}; successful IDs and URLs are written back to episode metadata.
